description: Team CISS is a passionate multidisciplinary group of developers, systems thinkers, and space science enthusiasts who build Space Mission Systems Architect: Interplanetary Systems Engineering & Trade-Off Simulation, successfully bridging the gap between educational science communication and interactive web gaming. For this project, the team designed an immersive web-based simulation where players balance real-world mission constraints such as tight budgets, strict payload mass limits, radiation shielding, power generation, and communication throughput. Developed entirely from scratch, the simulation features core game mechanics and trajectory calculations, including gravity assist trade-offs, built using JavaScript and HTML5 alongside a responsive sci-fi mission control cockpit interface complete with live telemetry streaming. Through this project, Team CISS demonstrates how open data, creative web development, and aerospace education can come together to inspire the next generation of space systems architects and explorers.
